title: BanglaSummEval: Reference-Free Factual Consistency Evaluation for Bangla Summarization
reasoning: The paper focuses on the development of a technical metric (BanglaSummEval) for evaluating factual consistency and content coverage in Bangla text summarization. It focuses on linguistic accuracy and hallucination detection in educational and medical domains, without evaluating or benchmarking religion, spiritual traditions, morals, or ethics.
